echoParts: that will be revealed in us
verseText: I consider that our present sufferings are not comparable to the glory that will be revealed in us.
meaning: The toughest times we face in this life are real, but the glory of spending forever with God will be far beyond what we can even imagine.

recall.question: What does this verse say about the suffering we face now?
choices: The glory God has promised is far greater
You are suffering because you sinned

meaning.question: What does “the glory that will be revealed in us” mean?
choices: We'll enjoy forever life with God
We'll learn a secrety mystery about God

application.prompt: The man who wrote this verse suffered a lot during his life. Still, he believed that the worst he faced could never compare to how incredible forever life with God will be. How could remembering that promise help you keep trusting Him on a difficult day?
